title: OWNER (optional, ~1 min): wake/check the Mac running the automation — it has been offline ~7h and missed today's scans
detail: The Mac supervisor (mac-local) that drives the Coconala/CrowdWorks browser work has been unable to run since 2026-10-10 13:13 JST: its last heartbeat was 'supervisor backoff after git_network (failure 3)' and no heartbeat has landed since. Both of today's scheduled scans (CrowdWorks 10:00 JST, Coconala 19:00 JST) did not run, and last real work was 10/09 19:04 JST (~25h ago). This looks like either a closed/asleep Mac (likely, it's the weekend) or a Mac-side network/GitHub-auth break — the cloud Founder cannot touch the Mac to fix it. WHAT HELPS (only if convenient): make sure the Mac is awake and online with the AIRevenueExperiment supervisor running (it has KeepAlive and self-restarts on wake/login); if it stays offline, confirm it can reach github.com (the git_network error blocks it from pushing scan results). NO action is needed if you'll be using the Mac again soon — the supervisor resumes on its own once the Mac is awake and online. This does NOT block the CrowdWorks owner ask above: pasting the ¥8,000 draft (apply-by 10/12) uses your own browser, not this Mac.
